As a 29-year-old White, non-Hispanic male who supports the Democratic party and has attended some level of college, I believe that promoting democracy and human rights is a fundamental aspect of American values and a key component of our foreign policy. I strongly favor this approach because I believe it aligns with my liberal values and the ideals of the Democratic party, which emphasizes the importance of promoting human rights and democracy globally. By using diplomacy and financial support, I believe the US can effectively promote these values without resorting to military intervention or other coercive measures.
